correctness.rationale: Cauchy's exact facet formula is reconstructed from all six triangles; face areas and normals and max identity are checked. The maximum enumerates all 64 facet-normal sign sums, and the minimum follows from pointed-polyhedral-sign-cone extreme rays and enumerates all 15 pairs of normal planes, reducing to three explicit, globally available ray types. Exact squared-difference factorization establishes both switching heights. Monotonicity establishes global uniqueness of h=3/4. An independent 2D convex hull calculation plus full finite ray/sign enumeration corroborate the proof for specified heights; numerical sampling is not an infinite proof.
